name: JohnPac, LLC
old_description: Absolutely. JohnPac specializes in custom industrial packaging, offering tailored solutions such as custom sizes, printing, and materials to fit specific business requirements.
about:
Founded in 1953, JohnPac, LLC has operated from Crowley, Louisiana for over 70 years. The company began as a packaging supplier and grew into a domestic manufacturer of woven polypropylene bags and a distributor of industrial packaging products.

JohnPac manufactures woven polypropylene bags, BOPP bags, laminated bags, and FIBCs (flexible intermediate bulk containers) at its domestic facility. It also maintains a distribution center stocked with more than 3,500 industrial packaging products and operates a dedicated fleet of delivery trucks to serve customers across the American South and nationwide.

The company serves government agencies, agriculture, construction, minerals, food stuffs, and chemical manufacturing sectors. Its packaging solutions are used for bulk agricultural products, industrial chemicals, specialty materials, and government supply requirements, including UN‑certified bulk bags for hazardous materials.

JohnPac emphasizes on‑time delivery, a comprehensive inventory, and domestic manufacturing as keys to an uninterrupted supply chain. Its mission is to be the most reliable American supplier for industrial packaging needs, offering custom sizes, printing, and materials tailored to each business.
